name: Bata Endura Sports Safety Shoes
description: BATA Endura sports safety shoes with steel toe combine robust protection with athletic comfort and style. Designed for demanding work environments, they offer steel-toe reinforcement, durable construction, and a sporty fit for all-day safety and performance.

name: Bata Zappy Low Cut Safety Shoes
description: The Bata Zappy is a range of lightweight, low-cut industrial safety shoes known for comfort and durability. They typically feature a steel toe cap for impact protection and are designed with a combination of leather and mesh uppers for breathability.

name: Bata Safety Shoes
description: The shoe is designed to be a lightweight, sporty option within the Rayo range, offering comfort and standard industrial protection.

name: Bata B Spot Safety Shoes
description: The Bata Endura B-Sport safety shoe is a low-ankle, lightweight industrial safety shoe featuring a steel toe for impact protection and a PU sole that is oil and slip-resistant. It is designed to provide safety and comfort for heavy-duty work environments.

name: Bata Zappy Safety Shoes
description: BATA Zappy single density safety shoes combine reliable protection with everyday comfort for industrial and workplace use. Designed with durable materials and safety features, they ensure secure footing and lasting wear on the job.

name: Yellow Construction Safety Helmet
description: Labour safety helmets, also known as hard hats, are vital personal protective equipment (PPE) designed to protect workers from head injuries caused by falling objects, impact with fixed obstacles, and electrical hazards

name: White Construction Safety Helmet
description: The headband should be more than 30mm in width. Cradle should be secured at minimum of four anchoring points. Straps should be anti-concussion and width not less than 19 mm. Straps should be fitted such that minimum clearance be at least 30 mm and maximum clearance more than 80 mm

name: 140 Joules PG MAXX Safety Shoes
description: PG Maxx double-density safety shoes, such as the RAGA - ZEUS PG Maxx, are robust, durable, and certified for industrial safety. They feature a double-density PU sole for superior comfort and slip resistance, a steel toe for impact protection, and high-quality leather uppers.

name: 100 Joules PG MAXX Safety Shoes
description: PG Maxx Industrial Leather Safety Shoe – Steel Toe, Low Ankle: These safety shoes feature a durable leather build with a reinforced steel toe cap for reliable protection in industrial environments. The low-ankle design offers flexibility and comfort, making them ideal for long workdays with enhanced safety and support

name: Abrigo N505 Polyester Hand Gloves
description: professional hand protection for high-risk tasks, using engineered fibers (like HPPE) and coatings (nitrile, PU) for excellent cut/abrasion resistance (often EN388 Level 3-5), dexterity, and grip, ideal for metal handling, automotive, glass work, and general assembly, balancing safety with comfort and flexibility for various industrial needs.

name: Kawach Leather Safety Shoes
description: Leather safety shoes are highly valued in demanding work environments due to the material's natural durability, abrasion resistance, and comfort that molds to your feet over time. They often include protective features like steel toe caps and slip-resistant soles, and are used across various industries from construction to logistics.

name: Industrial Safety Glasses
description: clear vision in demanding environments with advanced coatings like HydroShield and Uvextreme Plus, featuring models like the adjustable Uvex Avatar and Hypershock, providing impact protection, UV resistance, and comfort for industrial, lab, and outdoor use, with options for prescription (RX) and over-the-glasses (OTG) wear, ensuring durability and compliance with safety standard

description: Breathable, comfortable, and dexterous gloves made from knitted cotton, offering basic protection against scrapes, dirt, and minor hazards for general-purpose tasks like handling boxes, gardening, and light assembly

name: Reflective Safety Jacket
description: The purpose of reflective clothing, also known as high-visibility warning clothing, is to signal the presence of the user in places and situations which may cause potential threats to their health and safety.
